days.title: Castles and Historic Views
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schloss Laufen
stops.detail: The illumination of the Schloss Laufen on the Rhine Falls during the winter season is magical.

stops.name: Schlössli Wörth
stops.detail: For the first time, two historical castles, two cantons and two medieval Christmas markets combine to create a single great experience at Europe's largest waterfall. Around the mighty Rhine Falls, Laufen Castle and Wörth Castle open their venerable gates to merchants, craftsmen, musicians, jugglers and traveling folk.

stops.name: SBB-Brücke
stops.detail: Those who prefer firm ground under their feet can get from one market to the other via the famous SBB bridge with its impressive view of the Rhine Falls.
